profit.c2026: Rupali Bank PLC Q2 2026 (H1, Jan'26-Jun'26) DSE interim financial performance table (dsebd.org), live retrieval 2026-08-27. DSE's interim table does not publish an absolute net-profit figure directly, only EPS — this dataset derives net profit after tax as Basic EPS Half-Yearly cumulative (-13.13 BDT/share) × Total No. of Outstanding Securities (941,262,318) = BDT -12,358.77 million = -1235.877 ≈ -1236 crore (recorded in the source JSON as 'net_profit_after_tax_estimated_6m_cumulative', explicitly labeled a derived/estimated figure, not a bank-reported absolute profit line). H1 cumulative (6 months), not a full fiscal year figure — will change once the FY2026 annual report is published. — https://www.dsebd.org/displayCompany.php?name=RUPALIBANK

corporate_loan_pct.yr2021: Rupali Bank Limited Annual Report 2021: corporate/retail from Note 7.06 'Sector wise Loans' (Industry BDT 230,192,500,000; Consumer finance BDT 25,214,900,000; Total BDT 380,833,704,514). sme_pct from Directors' Report narrative: total CMSME portfolio 3873.50 crore vs total loans 38,083.37 crore. Directors' Report explicitly states 'Corporate credit is the largest section of the Bank... managed by the Industrial Credit Division' — basis for treating the 'Industry' line as corporate_pct.
